title: Load-time snap-floor check multiplies catalog i32s — in-range retune can wrap past the invariant check
detail: jint_strict bounds router_terminal_sep_tiles (>= 1, <= i32 max) but tile_px/snap_radius use lenient jint; sep=2147483647 with tile_px=2 wraps the i32 product to -2, silently passing the floor check and violating the documented E4 invariant.
recommended_fix: Do the comparison in i64 (i64(sep)*i64(tile_px) < i64(snap_radius)), matching placement_valid's own 'never wrap' convention, or parse tile_px/snap_radius via jint_strict.
